list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT CASE unit WHEN 'predefined.unit.NUMBER' THEN '–' WHEN 'predefined.unit.PERCENT' THEN '%' WHEN 'predefined.unit.acceleration.G' THEN 'g' WHEN 'predefined.unit.angle.DEGREE' THEN '°' WHEN 'predefined.unit.datavolume.BYTE' THEN 'byte' WHEN 'predefined.unit.flow.LITER_PER_HOUR' THEN 'l/h' WHEN 'predefined.unit.mass.METRIC_TON' THEN 't' WHEN 'predefined.unit.pressure.KILOPASCAL' THEN 'kPa' WHEN 'predefined.unit.rotation.RPM' THEN 'rpm' WHEN 'predefined.unit.speed.METERS_PER_SECOND' THEN 'm/s' WHEN 'predefined.unit.temperature.CELSIUS' THEN '°C' WHEN 'predefined.unit.time.HOUR' THEN 'hr' WHEN 'predefined.unit.voltage.VOLT' THEN 'V' WHEN 'predefined.unit.volume.LITER' THEN 'l' ELSE unit END AS unit_sym FROM signal WHERE signal_key = '${signal}' AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '72 hours'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__dateBin(time) AS time,
  machine_name,
  avg(value) AS value
FROM signal
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND signal_key = '${signal}'
  AND machine_name ~ '^${machine}$'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  machine_name,
  selector_last(value, time)['value'] AS value,
  selector_last(value, time)['time'] AS time,
  CASE unit WHEN 'predefined.unit.NUMBER' THEN '–' WHEN 'predefined.unit.PERCENT' THEN '%' WHEN 'predefined.unit.acceleration.G' THEN 'g' WHEN 'predefined.unit.angle.DEGREE' THEN '°' WHEN 'predefined.unit.datavolume.BYTE' THEN 'byte' WHEN 'predefined.unit.flow.LITER_PER_HOUR' THEN 'l/h' WHEN 'predefined.unit.mass.METRIC_TON' THEN 't' WHEN 'predefined.unit.pressure.KILOPASCAL' THEN 'kPa' WHEN 'predefined.unit.rotation.RPM' THEN 'rpm' WHEN 'predefined.unit.speed.METERS_PER_SECOND' THEN 'm/s' WHEN 'predefined.unit.temperature.CELSIUS' THEN '°C' WHEN 'predefined.unit.time.HOUR' THEN 'hr' WHEN 'predefined.unit.voltage.VOLT' THEN 'V' WHEN 'predefined.unit.volume.LITER' THEN 'l' ELSE unit END AS unit
FROM signal
WHERE signal_key = '${signal}'
  AND machine_name ~ '^${machine}$'
  AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '72 hours'
GROUP BY machine_name, unit
ORDER BY machine_name
